diacritic_error.title: Mäkčeň a dĺžeň
diacritic_error.explanation: Diacritics aren't decoration — the dĺžeň (´) lengthens the vowel and the mäkčeň (ˇ) softens the consonant. 'a' and 'á' are different sounds, 'c' and 'č' different letters. Slovak spelling is phonetic: write exactly what you hear.

ending_error.title: Endings do the work
ending_error.explanation: Slovak declines: word endings carry the grammar English does with word order and prepositions. 'Pezinok' becomes 'do Pezinka' (to) and 'v Pezinku' (in). Your stem was right — it's the ending that changes.

word_order.title: Second position
word_order.explanation: Slovak word order is freer than English, but the little grammar words (sa, si, som, mi, ti) lock into second position: 'Volám sa Ján', but 'Ako sa voláš?' — 'sa' rides in slot two either way.

retrieval_failure.title: It didn't surface
retrieval_failure.explanation: That's forgetting doing its job. The word is rescheduled to come back sooner — meeting it right at the edge of forgetting is exactly what makes it stick.

recognition_failure.title: Seen but not connected
recognition_failure.explanation: You've met this word, but the meaning didn't connect this time. Recognition and speaking are tracked separately — this one just needs more listening and reading reps.

confusion.title: Lookalikes collided
confusion.explanation: Two similar words collided. Slovak is full of minimal pairs — the contrast drills will keep pairing these until they separate in your head.

english_dependence.title: Reached for English
english_dependence.explanation: You leaned on English mid-sentence. Completely normal at this stage — when you're ready, the no-English runs are designed to wean this off.

transcript_disagreement.title: Not scored
transcript_disagreement.explanation: Two transcription engines heard different things, so nothing was scored — uncertainty is never held against you.
